title: Why Can You See Your Breath in Winter?
short_title: Why Your Breath Looks Like Smoke in Winter
description: On a cold morning your breath looks like smoke, but it is not smoke at all. Here is the simple science of water vapor turning into tiny droplets.
tags: why can you see your breath
comment: Did you try blowing 'smoke' this winter? Tell me below!

scenes.text: On a cold morning, your breath looks like smoke. But you are not on fire. So what are you actually seeing?
Inside your lungs, the air is warm and full of invisible water vapor. Every breath carries it out.
Outside, cold air cannot hold much vapor. The vapor cools down fast and squeezes together into tiny floating droplets of water.
Those droplets are so tiny they hang in the air, and they bounce light, so you see a little cloud.
On a warm day, the vapor stays invisible. Same breath, different temperature. A cloud, made by you!
